protocol.scope: Exactly three fresh sequential augmented runs, paired with existing same-seed baselines. No activation edits, no test evaluation, no commit.
protocol.test_policy: Only unlabeled FEN membership and file hashing for leak prevention. Test is never passed to an analyzer.
protocol.selection: Best validation-loss checkpoint; patience20 with min_delta0.0001, at most500 epochs. No extra tuning or retraining.
protocol.timing: Epoch compute includes updates and full train/validation loss. Process wall additionally includes loading/saving. Historical baselines, not interleaved timing trials.

augmentation.transform: rank reflection + piece/color/turn/castling/ep swap; unchanged class and counters; swapped optional White/Black
augmentation.key: 64 piece identities in FEN order + w/b + ep file (0 absent, 1..8); equivalent to all 777 encodeFEN values
augmentation.heldout_policy: FEN inputs only, no held-out labels parsed or used; validation wins overlap accounting when both

verification.label_policy: Only transform/involution checks for training labels; no label adjudication. Held-out labels never parsed.
